The dev container (see docs/adr/0007) forwards git credentials, so an agent
working in it can push. The one thing that must not happen by accident is a
release: scripts/webstore/release.js commits, tags and pushes branch AND tag to
origin, and a v*.*.* tag makes .github/workflows/release.yml publish to the
Chrome Web Store. It prompts only when stdin is a TTY, and --yes skips even that.
These rules stop the accident, not a determined agent - nothing here prevents
`git push origin HEAD:refs/tags/v3.4.0`, and only Claude Code reads this file.
Cutting a release is a host terminal, by hand: see RELEASE.md.
